articles.title: 【人事世界】今年 FairWork Case 特別多 – Sydney HR的日與夜
articles.summary: 澳洲嘅工作委員會今年收到嘅申請多到破紀錄，佢話同好多人用AI打官司有關。

levels.text: 澀洲嘅FWC今年收到超過五萬三千宗申請，破咗紀錄。這個數目一直在上升，並不是突然發生的。FWC話好多人用AI幫手打官司，令申請多咗。另外有一種叫General Protections的案件升得特別快，因為涉及僱員嘅權利。而家仲有更多人自己去代表自己打官司。
levels.text_en: Australia's FWC received over 53,000 applications this year, breaking records. This number has been rising steadily, not suddenly. FWC says many people are using AI to help with their legal cases, which has increased applications. Also, a type of case called 'General Protections' has been rising especially fast because it involves employee rights. Now more people are also representing themselves in these cases.

levels.text: 澳洲公平工作委員會（FWC）今年收到超過五萬三千宗申請，數字創歷史新高，比去年多兩成以上。主席Adam Hatcher表示，這個增長趨勢仍未放緩，委員會的運作方式已經到達一個轉捩點。FWC指出，AI的普及是申請增加的重要原因之一，因為它幫助不少人自行處理法律程序。此外，涉及僱員權利的General Protections dismissal案件增長特別快，比過去三年同期高出五成七。與此同時，越來越多申請人選擇自己代表自己出席聆訊，而不聘請律師。
levels.text_en: Australia's Fair Work Commission (FWC) received over 53,000 applications this year, a record high, more than 20% higher than last year. Chairman Adam Hatcher said this growth trend has not slowed down, and the Commission's way of operating has reached a turning point. FWC points out that the spread of AI is an important reason for the increase in applications, as it helps many people handle legal procedures themselves. In addition, General Protections dismissal cases, which involve employee rights, have grown especially fast — 57% higher than the same period over the past three years. Meanwhile, more and more applicants are choosing to represent themselves at hearings instead of hiring lawyers.

levels.text: 澳洲公平工作委員會（Fair Work Commission，FWC）2025– 26財政年度收到53,617宗申請，創下歷史新高。 相比2024–25年度嘅44,075宗，一年之間增加超過9, 500宗，升幅超過兩成。FWC主席Adam Hatcher日前亦公開表示， 目前嘅增長仲未見到有放慢或者見頂嘅跡象， 委員會甚至已經去到一個「十字路口」， 如果繼續以過去嘅方式處理工作，現有嘅運作、 績效及資源架構將難以持續。 呢個數字表面上睇，似乎係FWC突然面對一場「案件爆炸」。 但如果將時間拉長少少，其實會發現問題並唔係突然出現。 2023–24年度，FWC已經收到40,193宗申請； 2024–25年度再增加至44,075宗，而2025– 26年度更加去到53,617宗。即係話， 過去幾年嘅增長係持續發生，而唔係單純某一年突然出現異常。 既是如此，便值得傾下，「到底發生了甚麼事」？ FWC最近將人工智能列為重要因素，呢點並冇問題。 FWC嘅研究顯示，大約40% 個人申請人承認曾經使用AI協助準備或者處理自己嘅案件。 AI降低咗普通人進入法律程序嘅行政、認知同情緒門檻， 亦可以幫申請人理解程序、整理文件， 甚至協助判斷應該提出邊一類申請。FWC因此認為， AI係近期申請量急升嘅一個重要推動因素。 另外，FWC自己嘅數據已經顯示， 案件增加其實主要集中喺unfair dismissal同General Protections dismissal兩大類，而後者嘅增長尤其明顯。2024– 25年度，FWC收到6,209宗General Protections dismissal申請，比五年平均高27%；到2025– 26年度第一季，呢類申請達到2,102宗， 較過去三年同期平均高57%。FWC其後更加表示， General Protections dismissal申請喺截至2025–26年度嘅三年期間， 預計增加約80%。嘩！咩料？ General Protections本身同傳統嘅unfair dismissal並唔一樣。佢涉及workplace rights、adverse action、 discrimination以及其他受法律保護嘅理由。 換句話講，一宗僱傭關係終止嘅爭議，已經唔再只係「 公司炒人係咪公平」咁簡單，而係可以涉及公司點解作出決定、 僱員之前有冇提出投訴、行使權利、請假、 查詢薪酬或者其他受保護行為。 以前一個工作場所問題，可能係HR、 主管同僱員坐低傾一次就解決； 而家當雙方知道某一個行為可能牽涉General Protections，爭議就有機會由「人事問題」變成「 法律問題」。 第二個因素係自我代表（self-represented） 申請人增加。 FWC已經將self-represented applicants列為目前改革需要處理嘅
levels.text_en: Australia's Fair Work Commission (FWC) received 53,617 applications in the 2025–26 financial year, a record high. Compared to 44,075 in 2024–25, that's an increase of over 9,500 in one year, a rise of more than 20%. FWC Chairman Adam Hatcher recently publicly stated that the current growth shows no signs of slowing down or peaking, and the Commission has even reached a 'crossroads' — if it continues operating the way it has, the current operational, performance, and resource structures will be difficult to sustain. On the surface, this figure seems like FWC is suddenly facing a 'case explosion.' But if you look over a longer timeframe, the problem clearly didn't appear suddenly. In 2023–24, FWC already received 40,193 applications; this rose to 44,075 in 2024–25, and further to 53,617 in 2025–26. In other words, the growth over the past few years has been ongoing, not simply an anomaly appearing in one particular year. Given this, it's worth discussing 'what exactly happened?' FWC recently listed artificial intelligence as an important factor, and this makes sense. FWC's research shows that about 40% of individual applicants admitted to having used AI to help prepare or handle their own cases. AI lowers the administrative, cognitive, and emotional barriers for ordinary people entering legal processes, and can help applicants understand procedures, organize documents, and even help determine what type of application to file. FWC therefore believes AI is an important driver of the recent surge in applications. Additionally, FWC's own data shows that the increase in cases is mainly concentrated in two major categories: unfair dismissal and General Protections dismissal, with the latter's growth being especially notable. In 2024–25, FWC received 6,209 General Protections dismissal applications, 27% higher than the five-year average; by the first quarter of 2025–26, this type of application reached 2,102, 57% higher than the average for the same period over the past three years. FWC further stated that General Protections dismissal applications are expected to increase by about 80% over the three-year period up to 2025–26. Wow! What's going on? General Protections itself is different from traditional unfair dismissal. It involves workplace rights, adverse action, discrimination, and other legally protected grounds. In other words, a dispute over termination of employment is no longer simply about 'whether the company's dismissal was fair' — it can involve why the company made its decision, whether the employee had previously made complaints, exercised rights, taken leave, inquired about pay, or engaged in other protected activities. In the past, a workplace issue might be resolved with one sit-down conversation between HR, a supervisor, and the employee; now, when both parties know that a certain action might involve General Protections, the dispute has the potential to shift from a 'personnel issue' to a 'legal issue.' The second factor is the increase in self-represented applicants. FWC has listed self-represented applicants as one of the issues that current reforms need to address...

articles.summary_en: An HR-focused article discusses a sharp, record-breaking rise in cases filed with Australia's Fair Work Commission (FWC) this year, exploring why applications are surging and what's driving the trend.

articles.title: 喪子後解凍22年胚胎　54歲希臘婦趕法律限制　2.5月成功植入胚胎
articles.summary: 54歲嘅希臘婦人喺個仔車禍死咗之後，用22年前冷凍嘅胚胎，喺限期前成功再生一個健康女嬰。

levels.text: 54歲嘅希臘婦人克里斯蒂娜同60歲嘅丈夫，他們21歲嘅仔佐治今年10月因車禍死咗。夫婦決定用22年前冷凍的胚胎，再嘗試生小朋友。希臘法律規定女人做人工受孕不可以超過54歲，佢哋只剩返2.5個月。醫生幫手，在限期前成功植入胚胎，之後誕下健康女嬰，改名叫佐治亞，紀念過世嘅哥哥。
levels.text_en: A 54-year-old Greek woman named Cristina and her 60-year-old husband lost their 21-year-old son George in a car accident this past October. The couple decided to try to have a child using an embryo that had been frozen 22 years earlier. Greek law says a woman cannot undergo IVF after age 54, and they had only 2.5 months left before that deadline. With doctors' help, the embryo was successfully implanted before the deadline, and she later gave birth to a healthy baby girl, whom they named Georgia in memory of their late son.

levels.text: 希臘一名54歲婦人克里斯蒂娜和60歲丈夫康斯坦丁諾斯，在2025年10月痛失21歲長子佐治，他在車禍中身亡。夫婦決定使用22年前人工受孕時冷凍的備用胚胎，再次嘗試生育。根據希臘法律，女性接受人工受孕的年齡上限是54歲，克里斯蒂娜當時距離這個上限只剩2.5個月。在醫療團隊協助下，她完成了所有評估和批准，並在限期前成功植入胚胎。最終她在雅典一間私立醫院順利誕下健康女嬰，體重3.49公斤，命名為佐治亞，以紀念過世的長子。這宗罕見案例引發社會對人工受孕年齡限制的討論。
levels.text_en: A 54-year-old Greek woman named Cristina and her 60-year-old husband Konstantinos suffered the loss of their 21-year-old eldest son George in October 2025, who died in a car accident. The couple decided to use a spare embryo that had been frozen 22 years earlier during IVF treatment, to try to have a child again. Under Greek law, the upper age limit for women undergoing IVF is 54, and Cristina had only 2.5 months left before reaching that limit. With the help of a medical team, she completed all the necessary evaluations and approvals, and successfully had the embryo implanted before the deadline. She eventually gave birth safely to a healthy baby girl weighing 3.49 kg at a private hospital in Athens, and named her Georgia in memory of her late eldest son. This rare case has sparked public discussion about age limits for IVF.

levels.text: 延伸閱讀： 美國夫婦利用冷凍30年胚胎誕下男嬰 創「年齡最大嬰兒」新紀錄 車禍奪走愛子 夫婦盼藉冷凍胚胎重獲新生 據《美聯社》報道，54歲婦人克里斯蒂娜（Cristina Rapti-Tzelepi）與60歲丈夫康斯坦丁諾斯（Constantinos Raptis）原本擁有幸福的家庭，但他們21歲的長子佐治（Giorgos）於2025年10月在車禍中不幸身亡。面對中年喪子的悲痛，這對夫婦決定嘗試使用22年前進行人工受孕時所冷凍保存的備用胚胎，為家庭尋求第二次機會。 「54歲加1天即違法」 2.5個月克服重重困難誕下新生兒 根據希臘現行法例，女性接受人工受孕療程的法定年齡上限為54歲，主診醫生兼希臘生殖醫學會秘書長潘托斯（Dr. Kostas Pantos）接受採訪時說「54歲加1天都不行」。克里斯蒂娜坦言，當她下定決心再次懷孕時，距離超越54歲法定上限僅剩約2.5個月的時間，必須在極短時間內完成所有複雜的醫療評估，並取得國家輔助生殖管理局的官方批准。 在醫療團隊的協助下，克里斯蒂娜克服了高齡懷孕的生理與心理障礙，成功在期限屆滿前完成胚胎植入，終在雅典1所私立醫院順利剖腹產下重3.49公斤（7.7磅）的健康女嬰。夫婦2人將女兒命名為佐治亞（Georgia），以紀念過世的長子佐治。 丈夫康斯坦丁諾斯感嘆： 妻子克里斯蒂娜則表示： 延伸閱讀： 74歲母躺病床6歲女兒餵奶 中國自然受孕最高齡產婦近況曝光惹議 解凍22年胚胎成功極罕見 引發人工受孕年齡限制大討論 將冷凍長達22年的胚胎成功解凍並孕育出嬰兒，在國際醫學臨床歷史上相當罕見。國際醫學期刊《Human Reproduction Open》關於冷凍胚胎技術的研究，深低溫保存技術理論上可長久儲存胚胎，但在解凍過程中的復甦率以及高齡產婦的子宮環境都是極大考驗。過往也曾有 美國夫婦利用冷凍超過30年的胚胎成功誕下雙胞胎 的事例。 潘托斯醫生指出，這宗案例再次引發了社會對希臘人工受孕年齡限制的討論。鑑於希臘近年正面臨嚴重的生育率下降與人口老化問題，潘托斯呼籲當局檢討現行法例： 延伸閱讀： 深圳女懷孕宮內外不見孕囊 胚胎竟長腹動脈上 隨時大出血沒命
levels.text_en: Further reading: A U.S. couple used an embryo frozen for 30 years to give birth to a baby boy, setting a new record for the 'oldest embryo baby.' Car accident takes beloved son; couple hopes frozen embryo offers new life. According to the Associated Press, 54-year-old Cristina Rapti-Tzelepi and her 60-year-old husband Constantinos Raptis originally had a happy family, but their 21-year-old eldest son Giorgos died unfortunately in a car accident in October 2025. Facing the grief of losing a son in middle age, the couple decided to try using a spare embryo that had been frozen 22 years earlier during IVF treatment, seeking a second chance for their family. '54 years old plus one day would be illegal' — overcoming numerous difficulties in 2.5 months to give birth to a new baby. Under current Greek law, the legal age limit for women to undergo IVF treatment is 54. The attending physician and Secretary-General of the Hellenic Society of Assisted Reproduction, Dr. Kostas Pantos, said in an interview, 'Even 54 years and one day would not be allowed.' Cristina admitted that when she made up her mind to try to conceive again, she had only about 2.5 months left before exceeding the legal age limit of 54, and had to complete all the complex medical evaluations in an extremely short time and obtain official approval from the National Authority for Assisted Reproduction. With the help of the medical team, Cristina overcame the physical and psychological obstacles of an advanced-age pregnancy and successfully completed the embryo implantation before the deadline expired. She eventually gave birth via cesarean section at a private hospital in Athens to a healthy baby girl weighing 3.49 kg (7.7 lbs). The couple named their daughter Georgia, in memory of their late eldest son George. Husband Constantinos remarked: [quote not given]. Wife Cristina said: [quote not given]. Further reading: A 74-year-old mother lying in a hospital bed breastfeeds her 6-year-old daughter — update on China's oldest natural-conception mother sparks controversy. Successful thawing of a 22-year frozen embryo is extremely rare, sparking major debate on age limits for IVF. Successfully thawing an embryo frozen for as long as 22 years and having it develop into a baby is quite rare in international medical clinical history. According to research on frozen embryo technology published in the international medical journal Human Reproduction Open, deep cryopreservation technology can theoretically store embryos for a long time, but the survival rate during thawing and the uterine environment of older mothers are both major challenges. There was also a previous case of a U.S. couple successfully giving birth to twins using an embryo frozen for over 30 years. Dr. Pantos pointed out that this case has once again sparked social discussion about Greece's age limits for IVF. Given that Greece has in recent years faced serious declining birth rates and an aging population, Dr. Pantos called on authorities to review the current law: [quote not given]. articles.summary_en: A Greek couple lost their 21-year-old son in a car accident and decided to use embryos frozen 22 years earlier to try to have another child, racing against a legal age limit for fertility treatment. The story appeared in Chinese-language news reports citing an AP report.

articles.title: 【我在墓園工作】拍攝墓園小動物爆紅 巴黎守墓人揭秘工作日常 「我認為自己三生有幸」 這裏除逝者之外還蘊藏了甚麼？
articles.summary: 呢個巴黎守墓人影到狐狸相爆紅，仲寫咗本書講墓園入面嘅動物同人生。

levels.text: 班諾瓦是巴黎一個公墓嘅管理人。佢影到一隻狐狸嘅相，喺網上好紅。之後他寫咗一本書，講吓墓園入面嘅小動物、遊人和自己嘅生活。他話喺墓園做嘢好開心，唔覺得驚。佢同老婆仔女搬咗入墓園宿舍住。佢話要同小朋友講死亡嘅事，不可以呃佢哋。
levels.text_en: Benoit is the manager of a cemetery in Paris. He took a photo of a fox, which became very popular online. Afterwards he wrote a book about the small animals, visitors, and his own life in the cemetery. He says working in the cemetery makes him happy and he doesn't feel scared. He moved into the cemetery staff housing together with his wife and children. He says you should talk to children about death and not lie to them.

levels.text: 班諾瓦·加洛是巴黎拉雪茲神父公墓的管理人。他在墓園拍到一隻狐狸的照片，這張照片在網上非常受歡迎，還登上了報紙頭版。之後，他把自己在墓園的工作寫成一本書，介紹墓園裡的動物、遊客和逝者家屬的故事。他覺得能在這裡工作十分幸運，並不覺得可怕。他還和妻子、孩子一起搬進墓園的宿舍居住。他認為，父母應該帶孩子認識墓園，並誠實地和他們談論死亡，不要隱瞞。
levels.text_en: Benoît Gallot is the manager of Père-Lachaise Cemetery in Paris. He took a photo of a fox in the cemetery, which became extremely popular online and even made the front page of a newspaper. Afterwards, he turned his work at the cemetery into a book, introducing the animals, visitors, and stories of the deceased's families found there. He feels very fortunate to be able to work there and does not find it frightening. He and his wife and children moved into staff housing in the cemetery. He believes parents should bring their children to get to know the cemetery, and should talk to them honestly about death rather than hiding things from them.

levels.text:
近年愈來愈多到訪巴黎的旅人，將墓園視為必訪景點，不少當地導遊甚至推出墓園導賞團，似乎已是見慣不怪、尋常不過的現象。

當人們不再對墓園避而遠之，那麼，你又會否對那些默默地打理墓塚、為墓園付出勞動的管理人員，感到一絲好奇呢？守墓人這份工作，到底是一份悠閒的優差，還是陰冷可怕、受盡日曬雨淋的苦差呢？

巴黎拉雪茲神父公墓管理人班諾瓦・加洛，對工作投放異乎尋常的熱誠，視之為上天掉下來的禮物。他撰寫的《巴黎墓園的秘密生活》，揭開了「守墓人」這份職業的神秘面紗。

墓園管理人拍下狐狸身影 意外爆紅

位於巴黎市中心、「星光熠熠」的拉雪茲神父公墓（Cimetière du Père-Lachaise），佔地約四十四公頃，愛爾蘭作家王爾德、法國作家普魯斯特、劇作家莫里哀及音樂家蕭邦等巨擘在此長眠，每年吸引約三百萬名遊人來訪。

二〇二〇年新冠疫情期間，巴黎經歷封城，市面冷清，人跡寥落。墓園管理人班諾瓦・加洛（Benoît Gallot）獨自在墓園踱步時，遇上了一隻狐狸，並拍下牠的身影。出乎意料地，照片在社交平台上「爆紅」，亦登上《巴黎人報》頭版，不久後有電視台作出報道。

隨着加洛的Instagram帳號「墓園生活」(La Vie au Cimetière）追蹤人數節節上升，他決心不讓墓園淡出公眾視線範圍，於是將工作日常寫成《巴黎墓園的秘密生活》，向讀者展示墓園不為人知的一面。在宏觀層面，他爬梳墓園的歷史、演變歷程和法規改革；在微觀層面，他記錄墓園的小動物、遊人、逝者家屬、自己的職業生涯和家庭。

家族從事殯葬業 在墓碑之間成長

加洛的家族經營大理石公司，是殯葬業不可或缺的一環。他從小便與各式各樣的墓碑共處，養成對殯葬有一股莫以名狀的情意結。長大後，他雖然在大學修讀法律系，卻未有順理成章地成為執業律師，反而在因緣際會之下，踏進公務員體系，任職於公墓部門，在二〇一八年被委任為拉雪茲神父公墓的管理人。

他的職責包括編配墓位、跟不同逝者家屬協調下葬流程、挖墓、日常修護、維持遊人秩序、協調八十名墓園工作人員的工作等等，是一個不折不扣的守墓人。

在一般人的想像中，守墓人這個職業，必定是被分派至杳無人煙、陰森孤寂的墳場，遊走在墳墓之間，巡視及打理環境，偶爾還會碰上詭異事情，更分分鐘因為工作性質而「無朋友、斷六親」。

可是加洛在書本中，卻呈現出一種另類的生活景象，打破了一般人對守墓人的刻板印象。單單觀看中文版封面，便予人一種輕鬆愉快的感覺。他所管理的墓園，每日來訪者絡繹不絕，熱鬧非常；微風吹過，樹影婆娑，躲在角落的小動物探出頭來，為墓園增添了不少生命氣息。

這個生生不息的風景，乃多得巴黎市議會在二〇一一年通過的的決議——逐步減少在墓園範圍使用農藥和除草劑，讓不同品種的植物和動物，都能夠蓬勃生長和繁殖，維持生物多樣性。

連同妻兒搬進墓園宿舍

為了方便工作，加洛更與妻兒一家搬進墓園的員工宿舍。儘管妻子起初感到不安和茫然，但是隨時間而適應了在墓園的生活。由於她對墓園過於習以為常，在加洛的鼓勵下，她離開原本從事的餐飲業，轉戰殯葬業，擔任起殯葬顧問。

至於加洛的四名子女，已將墓園視為生活的一部分，在墓碑林立的小徑上學會踏單車，也不會因為「在墓園長大」或「父母都從事殯葬業」而感到不自在。加洛認為，父母完全可以帶小孩子參觀墓園，並建議必須要與孩子討論有關死亡的問題，最重要的是：「不要說謊，不要隱瞞任何事實，以免讓孩子獨自面對他們的疑慮和不安，那肯定更糟糕。」

當別人在奇怪：「你怎麼能夠在如此陰森的環境下工作？一定很可怕吧！」加洛卻希望用盡唇舌解釋：「我認為自己真是三生有幸。」

「我喜歡墓園，因為我向來深信它們大多數不是悲傷或陰森之地，而是能撫慰人心的地方，蘊藏令人意想不到的豐富性。」閱讀這本書，我們能夠看到在墓園裏，不止有「死亡」，還有城市規劃、文化歷史、生態環境、墓園管理人員的勞動，以及加洛對這份「不尋常」工作的熱愛。

In recent years, more and more visitors to Paris have come to see cemeteries as must-visit attractions, with local guides even offering cemetery tours — this has become an unremarkable, common phenomenon.

Now that people no longer avoid cemeteries, might you also feel a bit curious about the caretakers who quietly maintain the graves and put in the labor for these cemeteries? Is being a cemetery caretaker a leisurely, cushy job, or a grim, frightening task spent exposed to sun and rain?

Benoît Gallot, curator of Père-Lachaise Cemetery in Paris, brings unusual enthusiasm to his work, viewing it as a gift from heaven. His book, 'The Secret Life of a Paris Cemetery,' lifts the veil on the mysterious profession of the 'cemetery keeper.'

Cemetery Manager's Fox Photo Unexpectedly Goes Viral

Located in central Paris, the star-studded Père-Lachaise Cemetery covers about forty-four hectares. Great figures such as Irish writer Oscar Wilde, French writer Marcel Proust, playwright Molière, and composer Chopin are buried there, drawing about three million visitors each year.

During the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020, Paris went into lockdown, and the city became quiet and empty. While walking alone through the cemetery, curator Benoît Gallot encountered a fox and photographed it. Unexpectedly, the photo went viral on social media and even appeared on the front page of Le Parisien; soon after, television stations reported on it.

As followers of Gallot's Instagram account 'La Vie au Cimetière' (Cemetery Life) steadily grew, he decided not to let the cemetery fade from public attention, so he wrote about his daily work in the book 'The Secret Life of a Paris Cemetery,' showing readers a side of the cemetery that people don't usually see. On a broad level, he traces the cemetery's history, evolution, and regulatory reforms; on a detailed level, he records the small animals, visitors, families of the deceased, his own career, and his family life in the cemetery.

Family in the Funeral Industry, Growing Up Among Gravestones

Gallot's family runs a marble company, an essential part of the funeral industry. From childhood he lived among all kinds of gravestones, developing an inexplicable attachment to funerary matters. Growing up, although he studied law at university, he did not go on to become a practicing lawyer as one might expect; instead, through a twist of fate, he entered the civil service system, working in the cemetery department, and was appointed curator of Père-Lachaise Cemetery in 2018.

His responsibilities include allocating burial plots, coordinating burial procedures with different families of the deceased, digging graves, daily maintenance, keeping order among visitors, and coordinating the work of eighty cemetery staff members — he is a true 'cemetery keeper' in every sense.

In most people's imagination, a cemetery keeper must be someone assigned to a desolate, eerie, lonely graveyard, wandering among graves, patrolling and maintaining the grounds, occasionally encountering strange occurrences, and perhaps even becoming isolated from friends and family due to the nature of the job.

But in his book, Gallot presents an alternative picture of life that breaks the stereotype people have of cemetery keepers. Just looking at the cover of the Chinese edition gives one a relaxed, cheerful feeling. The cemetery he manages receives a steady stream of visitors every day and is quite lively; a breeze blows, tree shadows sway, and small animals hiding in corners poke their heads out, adding a touch of life to the cemetery.

This thriving scene is thanks to a resolution passed by the Paris City Council in 2011 — gradually reducing the use of pesticides and herbicides within cemetery grounds, allowing different species of plants and animals to grow and reproduce abundantly, maintaining biodiversity.

Moved into Cemetery Housing with Wife and Children

To make his work more convenient, Gallot moved with his wife and children into the cemetery's staff housing. Although his wife initially felt uneasy and lost, she adapted to cemetery life over time. Having become so accustomed to the cemetery, with Gallot's encouragement she left her original career in the food and beverage industry and switched to the funeral industry, becoming a funeral consultant.

As for Gallot's four children, they have come to see the cemetery as part of their daily life, learning to ride bicycles on the paths lined with gravestones, and they do not feel uncomfortable about 'growing up in a cemetery' or having 'parents who work in the funeral industry.' Gallot believes parents can absolutely bring children to visit cemeteries, and suggests it is essential to discuss questions about death with children. Most importantly: 'Don't lie, don't hide any facts, so as not to leave children to face their doubts and anxieties alone — that would definitely be worse.'

When others wonder, 'How can you work in such a gloomy environment? It must be terrifying!' Gallot tries his best to explain: 'I truly consider myself extremely fortunate.'

'I love cemeteries, because I have always firmly believed that most of them are not sad or eerie places, but places that can comfort the heart, holding an unexpectedly rich abundance.' Reading this book, we can see that in the cemetery, there is not only 'death,' but also urban planning, cultural history, ecological environment, the labor of cemetery staff, and Gallot's love for this 'unusual' job.

articles.summary_en: This is a Cantonese/Chinese-language article about Benoît Gallot, the caretaker (curator) of Père-Lachaise Cemetery in Paris, who became famous for a photo of a fox and later wrote a book about cemetery life.

articles.title: 概念的限度

levels.text:
除了傅柯，另一個我喜歡的歐陸哲學家是阿多諾（Theodor W. Adorno）。阿多諾的思想艱深，文字亦不容易讀；可是，他有些看法，我一旦明白了，便深刻留在腦中，改變我思考問題的方式。我對阿多諾哲學的興趣，其中一個起點是他所說的 non-identity，通常譯作「非同一性」。

阿多諾的「非同一性」，意思當然不只是說兩件不同的事物並不同一；這麼明顯的一點，用不著哲學家煞有介事提出。阿多諾也不是在搞邏輯學，要否定「A = A」。Non-identity 關乎概念與其對象之間的關係：一個概念即使用得完全正確，也不等於把它的對象完全說盡。

我們思考，主要透過運用概念。看見眼前的東西，認出那是一張桌子；目睹某人匆匆跑進課室，判斷他是學生；身體不適，按病徵認為是流感。這些都是我們透過運用概念，把遇到的東西辨認為某種事物。沒有這種能力，我們根本不能理解世界。

然而，這裏說的「東西」或「事物」，只是為了方便說明，不是指一件在概念運用之前已經被我們確定為甚麼的東西。當我們把眼前所見辨認為一張桌子，這本身已經是概念運用的結果；就這項辨認而言，「桌子」這個概念可以用得完全正確，non-identity 不是說我們不能把它完全正確地辨認為桌子，而是說一次正確的概念應用，並不等於窮盡了它的對象。

舉個簡單的例子：你說前面站著的是一個人。假如你沒有說錯，那麼你是正確地把「人」這個概念應用到眼前的對象；可是，這個正確的判斷並沒有把對象完全說盡。假如你改說前面站著的是一個男人，那是更具體了，因為你把範圍較窄的「男人」概念應用於同一對象。可是，這仍然沒有把他完全說盡：他還是個三十歲的男人、某人的丈夫、科學家、一九九○年代出生的人、一個碳基生物，一大堆原子的組合體等等。這些說法從不同方面描述同一對象，可以全部正確，卻沒有任何一個單獨概念的應用能成為這個對象的完整描述。

"Non-identity"
最簡單的意思，就是對象不能等同於我們對它作出的任何一項概念性規定 。阿多諾把那種忽視了「概念的正確應用」與「完全理解對象」之間仍有距離的思考，稱為 "identity thinking（同一性思維）"。問題不在於我們用概念作了分類，而在於分類和應用概念後，便以為理解也完滿無缺了。

上述例子，與維根斯坦在《哲學研究》開頭對 pointing 的討論，有異曲同工之妙。假如我指著兩顆堅果，向一個不懂中文的人說：「兩個。」單憑辨認手指的方向及指向的東西，聽者不能知道我要教的是數目、堅果的名稱，還是堅果的某種性質。Pointing 看似只是用手指指向事物，其實已經是在運用概念。同一個指向的動作，可以是應用不同的概念：不同的概念，可以應用到那兩顆堅果，而每一概念的應用都不能窮盡其性質或面向。

阿多諾不是要我們跳到概念之外來理解世界，那是不可能的；他只是要求我們對概念的限度保持警覺，從而幫助我們對世界的理解保持開放性。我們仍要運用概念作分類，給事物命名；另一方面，則要繼續從不同方向理解事物，並容許對象反過來修改我們的概念。
levels.text_en:
Besides Foucault, another continental philosopher I like is Theodor W. Adorno. Adorno's thought is difficult and his writing is not easy to read; but some of his views, once I understood them, stayed deeply in my mind and changed the way I think about problems. One starting point for my interest in Adorno's philosophy is what he called 'non-identity,' usually translated as 'fei tong yi xing' (非同一性).

Adorno's 'non-identity' certainly does not simply mean that two different things are not identical to each other — such an obvious point would not need a philosopher to solemnly propose it. Nor is Adorno doing logic, trying to deny that 'A = A.' Non-identity concerns the relationship between a concept and its object: even when a concept is applied completely correctly, this does not mean that the object has been completely and exhaustively described by it.

We think mainly by using concepts. Seeing something in front of us and recognizing it as a table; seeing someone rush into a classroom and judging that he is a student; feeling unwell and, based on the symptoms, concluding it's the flu — these are all cases where we use concepts to identify what we encounter as a certain kind of thing. Without this ability, we simply could not understand the world.

However, the 'things' or 'objects' mentioned here are only for convenience of explanation; they do not refer to something already determined as such-and-such prior to our use of concepts. When we recognize what we see as a table, this recognition itself is already the result of applying a concept. As far as this act of recognition goes, the concept 'table' can be applied entirely correctly — non-identity does not mean that we cannot correctly recognize it as a table, but rather that one correct application of a concept does not exhaust the object.

Here is a simple example: you say that the thing standing in front of you is a person. If you are not mistaken, then you have correctly applied the concept 'person' to the object before you; but this correct judgment has not completely and exhaustively described the object. If you instead say that the thing standing in front of you is a man, that is more specific, because you have applied the narrower concept 'man' to the same object. But this still does not exhaust him: he is also a thirty-year-old man, someone's husband, a scientist, someone born in the 1990s, a carbon-based life form, an assembly of a large number of atoms, and so on. These descriptions describe the same object from different angles, and all of them can be correct, yet no single concept's application can constitute a complete description of this object.

The simplest meaning of 'non-identity' is that the object cannot be equated with any single conceptual determination we make of it. Adorno called the kind of thinking that ignores the remaining distance between 'the correct application of a concept' and 'the complete understanding of the object' 'identity thinking.' The problem is not that we use concepts to classify things, but that after classifying and applying concepts, we mistakenly believe that our understanding is now complete and without gaps.

The example above bears a striking resemblance to Wittgenstein's discussion of pointing at the beginning of Philosophical Investigations. If I point at two nuts and say to someone who does not understand Chinese, 'Two,' the listener, merely by observing the direction of my finger and what it points to, cannot know whether I am teaching the number, the name of the nuts, or some property of the nuts. Pointing may seem like merely directing a finger at something, but it is in fact already an application of a concept. The very same act of pointing can be the application of different concepts: different concepts can be applied to those two nuts, and the application of each concept can never exhaust their properties or aspects.

Adorno does not ask us to leap outside of concepts in order to understand the world — that would be impossible; he only asks us to remain alert to the limits of concepts, so as to help keep our understanding of the world open. We must still use concepts to classify things and give them names; on the other hand, we must continue to understand things from different directions, and allow the object, in turn, to modify our concepts.

articles.summary_en: The author reflects on the philosopher Theodor Adorno's idea of 'non-identity' (the gap between a concept and the full reality of its object), illustrating it with everyday examples like identifying a table or a person, and comparing it to Wittgenstein's discussion of pointing.

articles.title: 【馮睎乾十三維度】齊來欣賞李家超的KPI
articles.summary: 李家超話佢啲KPI好多都做到，但其實好多都係得個做字，冇乜實際成績。

levels.text: 李家超噉發表咗好多KPI，話大部分都做到。佢話有個話劇係為咗維護國家安全，其實得返幾百個學生睇。另外有一個法律網站，已經完成了，但入面嘅資料好舊。仲有一個工業計劃，佢話符合進度，但其實只有幾間公司申請，遠遠未夠數量。所以呢啲KPI，睇落好靚，其實冇乜用。
levels.text_en: John Lee announced many KPIs, saying most had been achieved. He said a stage play was held to safeguard national security, but actually only a few hundred students watched it. There's also a legal website that was completed, but the information inside is very outdated. There's also an industrial plan that he says is on track, but actually only a few companies applied, far short of the target number. So these KPIs look nice on the surface but are actually useless.

levels.text: 李家超公布了新一份施政報告的KPI進度，指大部分指標都已達標。但仔細看，很多所謂完成的項目其實做得很馬虎。例如保安局舉辦了一場國安話劇，但觀眾大多是小學生，規模很小。律政司說推出了大灣區法律資訊平台，可是網站內容陳舊，最新消息仍停留在六月。創新科技局的新型工業加速計劃聲稱符合進度，但兩年來只有九間公司獲批投資，遠遠未達到目標數量。作者認為這些KPI只是做做樣子，沒有實際意義。
levels.text_en: John Lee announced the KPI progress for the new policy address, stating that most indicators had been met. But looking closely, many so-called completed projects were done very sloppily. For example, the Security Bureau held a national security-themed stage play, but the audience was mostly primary school students, and the scale was small. The Department of Justice said it launched a Greater Bay Area legal information platform, but the website content is outdated, with the latest news still stuck in June. The Innovation and Technology Bureau's New Industrialisation Acceleration Scheme claims to be on track, but over two years only nine companies have been approved for investment, far short of the target number. The author believes these KPIs are just for show and have no real substance.

levels.text: 李家超昨天發表了什麼「五年計劃」和「施政報告」，一大堆黨八股——例如「五年計劃」所謂「七個堅持」，就是習近平常常掛在嘴邊的用語——我連看也沒興趣，只硬着頭皮瀏覽了新聞報道就作罷。唯獨一份附錄文件〈2025年《施政報告》指定項目指標的進度〉，讀下去才發覺頗有「娛樂性」。 以「交齊功課」出名的李家超，向來喜歡用KPI證明自己的存在價值。去年施政報告中，他設下79個新指標，另有61個之前訂下而仍未到期的舊指標，共140個指標。李家超今年在施政報告附篇匯報進度，除了3項指標外，其餘均列「符合進度」或「完成執行」。我好奇他究竟交了什麼功課，便打開附錄文件看看。 猜到打頭陣是什麼嗎？厲害了，就是「為維護國家安全」，保安局「舉行面向公眾的萬眾一心護國安的話劇匯演」，「進度」欄則寫：「完成執行。保安局已於2026年7月舉行一連兩場的國家安全話劇公演。」這個聽來波瀾壯闊的盛事，我翻查舊聞，才知道是指7月初東九文化中心公演的《國安家好社區食神大賽》——看官方照片，觀眾多數是小學鴨仔團，那「話劇」則有中學生聯歡晚會表演的水準。 我又隨機看看其他完成的指標。有項關於律政司的，指標說：「為推動大灣區的合作，在2026年上半年內推動建立粵港澳大灣區法律資訊平台。」「進度」寫：「完成執行。律政司已於2026年6月30日推出粵港澳大灣區法律資訊平台。」看到這「進度」，才知道律政司跟我有共通點：都是死線戰士。瀏覽該「資訊平台」，我發現只是個充斥無用資訊的普通網站（姑且不叫「十九網站」），「最新消息」仍滯留在6月12日律政司司長致辭，網站最後修訂日期是6月30日。 李家超領導下的政府完成這類KPI，固然對一般港人毫無意義——當然你可以話「搞話劇可以維護国家安全，意義重大喎」，悉隨尊便——就算對北京來說，我也懷疑他們的智力水平，會不會低到連這類為交貨而交貨的「指標」也照單全收。除了上述兩項隨機抽樣的KPI，這份〈指定項目指標的進度〉還有許多值得公眾和傳媒認真追問的地方，尤其是創新科技及工業局負責的「新型工業加速計劃」。 李家超之前訂下的指標是這樣寫的：「由2024–25年度起，透過『新型工業加速計劃』在五至八年內吸引50至100家企業在本港設立新智能生產設施，相應的企業直接投資不少於200億元。」「進度」欄說：「符合進度。截至2026年9月，『新型工業評審委員會』已公布支持九宗申請，企業投資金額約30億元。」我倒不太明白「符合進度」四字從何而來。 按照指標，把時間拖到最長也只有八年，把你「吸引」到的企業數量壓到最少，也要50家。想趕上進度，一年平均需要六七家企業的申請獲批，兩年下來就是十二至十四家。「新型工業加速計劃」是特區政府於2024年9月推出的資助計劃，如今兩年過去，只有九家企業報稱在香港投資而獲港府資助，連十二家的門檻也跨不過，請問怎樣「符合進度」呢？ 當然「數量」並非最重要，最重要是「
levels.text_en:
Yesterday John Lee published some 'Five-Year Plan' and 'Policy Address', full of Party jargon — for example the Five-Year Plan's so-called 'Seven Persistences' are just phrases Xi Jinping constantly repeats — I had no interest in reading it at all, and only forced myself to skim the news reports before giving up. Except for one appendix document, 'Progress of Designated Project Indicators in the 2025 Policy Address' — reading through it, I found it quite 'entertaining'.

John Lee, known for 'handing in complete homework', has always liked using KPIs to prove his worth. In last year's policy address, he set 79 new indicators, plus 61 old indicators previously set that hadn't yet expired, totaling 140 indicators. This year, in the appendix to the policy address, Lee reported progress, and apart from 3 indicators, all the rest were listed as either 'on track' or 'completed'. Curious about what homework he had actually handed in, I opened the appendix to take a look.

Guess what came first? Impressive — it was 'safeguarding national security': the Security Bureau 'held a public stage play performance uniting everyone to safeguard national security'. The 'Progress' column stated: 'Completed. The Security Bureau held two performances of a national security stage play in July 2026.' This grand-sounding event, when I checked old news, turned out to be the 'National Security Home Community Food God Competition' performed in early July at the East Kowloon Cultural Centre — looking at the official photos, the audience was mostly primary school duckling tour groups, and the 'stage play' had the standard of a middle school variety show performance.

I randomly checked a few other 'completed' indicators. One concerning the Department of Justice stated: 'To promote cooperation in the Greater Bay Area, establish a Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Legal Information Platform in the first half of 2026.' The 'Progress' column said: 'Completed. The Department of Justice launched the Greater Bay Area Legal Information Platform on 30 June 2026.' Seeing this 'progress', I realized the Department of Justice and I have something in common: we're both deadline warriors. Browsing this 'information platform', I found it just an ordinary website full of useless information (let's not call it a '19-website' for now) — the 'latest news' section was still stuck on the Secretary for Justice's speech from June 12, and the website's last revision date was June 30.

The government under John Lee's leadership completing these kinds of KPIs is, of course, meaningless to ordinary Hong Kong people — of course you could say 'putting on a stage play can safeguard national security, it's very significant', suit yourself — but even for Beijing, I doubt whether their intelligence level is low enough to accept these kinds of 'indicators' that exist purely for the sake of delivering something.

Besides the two randomly sampled KPIs above, this 'Progress of Designated Project Indicators' document has many more points worth serious scrutiny by the public and media, especially the 'New Industrialisation Acceleration Scheme' under the Innovation, Technology and Industry Bureau.

The indicator John Lee had previously set was written like this: 'Starting from 2024-25, through the New Industrialisation Acceleration Scheme, attract 50 to 100 enterprises to establish new smart production facilities in Hong Kong within five to eight years, with corresponding direct enterprise investment of no less than HK$20 billion.' The 'Progress' column said: 'On track. As of September 2026, the New Industrialisation Evaluation Panel has announced support for nine applications, with enterprise investment amounting to about HK$3 billion.' I really don't understand where the phrase 'on track' comes from.

According to the indicator, even stretching the timeframe to the maximum eight years, and taking the minimum number of enterprises to be 'attracted' at 50, to stay on track you'd need an average of six to seven approved enterprise applications per year — meaning twelve to fourteen over two years. The New Industrialisation Acceleration Scheme is a subsidy scheme launched by the SAR government in September 2024. Now, two years later, only nine enterprises have reported investing in Hong Kong and received government subsidies — not even reaching the twelve threshold. So how exactly is this 'on track'?

Of course, 'quantity' isn't the most important thing; the most important thing is...

articles.title: 《蘭香如故》是丫鬟升職記？　盤點明代3等丫鬟待遇與4條升職路徑
articles.summary: 明代嘅丫鬟分做三等，待遇各有唔同，仲有機會一步步升職做管家甚至做妾。

levels.text: 明代嘅丫鬟分做三等，各人嘅待遇都唔同。三等丫鬟沒有月錢，只包食包住。二等丫鬟可以攞到啲賞錢，仲可以住細房。一等大丫鬟管錢管人，是府內嘅管家。如果主人鍾意佢，仲可以升做妾侍。不過她們始終是奴婢，身份很難改變。
levels.text_en: Maidservants in the Ming Dynasty were divided into three ranks, each with different treatment. Third-rank maids had no monthly wage, only food and lodging provided. Second-rank maids could receive some reward money and could live in a small room. First-rank senior maids managed money and people, acting as household stewards. If the master favored her, she could even be promoted to become a concubine. However, they were still servants at heart, and their status was very hard to change.

levels.text: 明代的丫鬟按照身份分為三等，每等待遇都不同。三等丫鬟沒有固定月錢，只能得到基本的衣食。二等丫鬟負責貼身照顧主人，有時會得到布料和首飾等賞賜。一等丫鬟則掌管內宅事務，權力最大，但仍然是奴婢身份。如果主人寵幸，丫鬟也有機會被納為妾，不過地位依然低微，隨時可能被轉賣或驅逐。小說《紅樓夢》和《金瓶梅》都描寫過這些丫鬟的生活，反映了明代社會的真實情況。
levels.text_en: Ming Dynasty maidservants were divided into three ranks according to status, with different treatment for each. Third-rank maids had no fixed monthly wage, only receiving basic clothing and food. Second-rank maids were responsible for personally attending to their masters, and sometimes received rewards such as cloth and jewelry. First-rank maids managed the affairs of the inner household and held the greatest power, but were still servants by status. If favored by the master, a maid also had a chance to be taken as a concubine, though her status remained low, and she could be sold off or expelled at any time. Novels such as 'Dream of the Red Chamber' and 'Jin Ping Mei' both depicted the lives of these maidservants, reflecting the real conditions of Ming Dynasty society.

levels.text: 待遇對照：小說的「月錢階梯」與明代的殘酷現實 在古代，白銀與銅錢（文）同時流通，明代萬曆年間，1兩白銀約等於1,000文銅錢。 三等丫鬟（粗使婢女/外房婢） 小說文學設定： 在《紅樓夢》書中，粗使三等丫鬟月錢為500文；《蘭香如故》的背景也借鑒了這套文學設定。《金瓶梅》甚少記載丫鬟固定月例，書中婢女多記買賣身價，而非按月支薪。她們多人擠在1間通鋪間，吃的是府內集體伙食，極少見到葷菜，沒有單獨的衣物配給，只有逢年過節才能得1套粗布新衣，平時拿不到任何賞錢，犯錯就會被責打甚至直接轉賣。 明代真實史料： 這類粗使婢女多為主人花錢買來的奴婢或是府內奴婢生的孩子（家生子）。在現實中，她們根本沒有月錢，主人僅包吃住；少數江南富裕人家，每月會給200至500文。她們住在外院群屋，穿粗布衣裳，吃粗糧。一旦生病，主人常會選擇直接轉賣，而非花錢醫治。 二等丫鬟（內房貼身婢女） 小說文學設定： 《金瓶梅》原文只記載這類丫鬟的購買身價，沒有明寫每月固定月錢。她們能住單獨小房或2人合住，吃的是主子剩下的飯菜，肉蛋更多。主子常賞賜零碎銀錢或頭面布料，她們可以出入內室，幫忙保管首飾與衣物。後世金學研究者推測，像小玉、玉簫這類貼身、管事大丫鬟，若參照《紅樓夢》的月例體系，待遇約在1–2兩銀之間。 明代真實史料： 江南富戶家的貼身婢女，通常需要具備精湛的針線手藝或照顧人的技巧，月錢在500文到1兩銀子之間。她們有相對獨立的住處，若手藝出眾，常能獲得布料與首飾的賞賜。 一等大丫鬟（管事丫鬟） 小說文學設定： 在《金瓶梅》中，吳月娘身邊的大丫鬟玉簫，書中並無固定月錢記載，後世研究者推測其待遇水準約折合2兩銀子（約2,000文）。她擁有獨立小房，伙食優厚，掌管內宅鑰匙，負責點驗銀兩、登記器物並調派低等丫鬟，辦事或逢年過節常有大筆賞銀。在《紅樓夢》中，大丫鬟平兒也是這類角色，手握內宅管理實權。但無論權力多大，她們本質上依然是奴婢，主人隨時可以處置。 明代真實史料： 據後世學者對晚明江南大族的研究，江南大族內宅的「管家婆」多由資深且極受信任的婢女擔任。她們不一定領固定月錢，更多是「俸米加不定期賞銀」，實際可支配的資源遠超普通婢女，在內宅權威極高，但奴籍身份終生難改。 通房/由婢升妾 小說文學設定： 《紅樓夢》妾室的定額津貼是2兩月錢，《金瓶梅》的孫雪娥原為陪嫁婢女，遭主人收用後獲得妾的名分，但《金瓶梅》原文未明確記載她的月錢。妾雖擁有獨立房舍與專屬小丫鬟，但因出身賤籍，地位遠低於正妻。 明代真實史料： 晚明社會常見主人收用家婢，《大明律》並無專條處罰家主與自家婢女私通，官府一般不會主動追究，但並非法律明文許可，一旦涉訟，會視案情處理。婢女即便生下子女，身份依然受限，失寵後隨時可能被驅逐或重新轉賣。 三等丫鬟升職的4條晉升路徑與硬性規則 從粗使小丫鬟到大宅門的高層，在歷史與小說中主要有4條晉升路徑： 底
levels.text_en:
Comparison of treatment: the 'monthly wage ladder' in novels versus the harsh reality of the Ming Dynasty. In ancient times, silver and copper coins (wen) circulated simultaneously; during the Wanli era of the Ming Dynasty, 1 tael of silver was roughly equal to 1,000 wen of copper coins.

Third-rank maids (rough-work servant girls / outer-quarters maids)
Literary/fictional setting: In 'Dream of the Red Chamber', third-rank rough-work maids received a monthly wage of 500 wen; the background of 'Lan Xiang Ru Gu' also draws on this literary setting. 'Jin Ping Mei' rarely records fixed monthly wages for maids—the book mostly records their purchase price rather than monthly pay. Many of them crowded into a single shared sleeping area, ate collective meals provided by the household, rarely saw meat dishes, had no individual clothing allowance, and only received one set of coarse cloth new clothes during festivals. Normally they got no reward money at all, and mistakes would result in beatings or even being sold off directly.
Historical records: This type of rough-work maid was mostly bought as a slave by the master, or was the child of household slaves born into servitude (jiashengzi). In reality, they had no monthly wage at all—the master only provided food and lodging; a small number of wealthy Jiangnan households would give 200 to 500 wen per month. They lived in shared outer-courtyard housing, wore coarse cloth clothing, and ate coarse grains. If they fell ill, masters often chose to sell them off directly rather than spend money on treatment.

Second-rank maids (inner-quarters personal attendants)
Literary/fictional setting: The original text of 'Jin Ping Mei' only records the purchase price of this type of maid, without explicitly stating a fixed monthly wage. They could live in a private small room or share with one other person, ate leftover food from their masters which included more meat and eggs. Masters often rewarded them with small amounts of silver money or hair ornaments and cloth, and they could enter the inner chambers and help manage jewelry and clothing. Later researchers of 'Jin Ping Mei' studies speculate that personal attendant/managing maids like Xiaoyu and Yuxiao, if compared to the monthly wage system in 'Dream of the Red Chamber', would have received treatment worth about 1–2 taels of silver.
Historical records: Personal attendant maids in wealthy Jiangnan households usually needed to have exceptional needlework skills or caregiving abilities, with monthly wages between 500 wen and 1 tael of silver. They had relatively independent living quarters, and if their skills were outstanding, they often received rewards of cloth and jewelry.

First-rank senior maids (managing maids)
Literary/fictional setting: In 'Jin Ping Mei', Yuxiao, the senior maid attending Wu Yueniang, has no fixed monthly wage recorded in the book, but later researchers estimate her treatment level to be equivalent to about 2 taels of silver (about 2,000 wen). She had her own private room, generous meals, managed the keys to the inner household, was responsible for checking silver, recording items, and assigning lower-ranked maids their duties; she often received large reward money for handling affairs or during festivals. In 'Dream of the Red Chamber', the senior maid Pinger is a similar character, holding real power in managing the inner household. However, no matter how much power they held, they remained servants at their core, subject to disposal by their masters at any time.
Historical records: According to later scholars' research on great Jiangnan clans in the late Ming, the 'housekeeper women' of the inner households of great clans were mostly senior and highly trusted maids. They did not necessarily receive a fixed monthly wage—more often it was 'rice stipend plus irregular reward money.' The resources they could actually control far exceeded those of ordinary maids, and they held very high authority within the inner household, but their status as bonded servants could not be changed for life.

Bed-servant / promotion from maid to concubine
Literary/fictional setting: In 'Dream of the Red Chamber', concubines received a fixed allowance of 2 taels per month. In 'Jin Ping Mei', Sun Xue'e was originally a maid who came as part of a dowry, and after being taken by the master, she gained the status of a concubine, but the original text of 'Jin Ping Mei' does not clearly record her monthly wage. Although a concubine had her own private quarters and a dedicated maid, because of her lowly origin her status was far below that of the primary wife.
Historical records: In late Ming society it was common for masters to take household maids as concubines. The 'Great Ming Code' had no specific article punishing a master for private relations with his own maid, and the authorities generally would not actively investigate, though it was not explicitly permitted by law either—if a lawsuit arose, it would be handled according to the circumstances of the case. Even if a maid bore children, her status remained restricted, and after falling out of favor she could be expelled or resold at any time.

articles.title: 李家超：《五年規劃》非計劃經濟 《施政報告》長遠謀劃全局
articles.summary: 李家超話聽日會出兩份重要文件，一份話香港未來嘅方向，一份就跟住呢個方向去做香港嘅大事。

levels.text: 李家超話聽日會出《五年規劃》同《施政報告》。他表示，《五年規劃》嘅封面係藍色，代表開放同穩重；《施政報告》就用綠色，代表希望和活力。佢話《五年規劃》唔係計劃經濟，只是講香港未來嘅方向；《施政報告》就係跟住呢個方向去諗香港嘅大事。政府仲整咗兩本摘要俾市民睇。
levels.text_en: John Lee said that tomorrow he will release the 'Five-Year Plan' and the 'Policy Address.' He said the cover of the 'Five-Year Plan' is blue, representing openness and steadiness; the 'Policy Address' uses green, representing hope and vitality. He said the 'Five-Year Plan' is not a planned economy, but just talks about Hong Kong's future direction; the 'Policy Address' follows this direction to think about Hong Kong's major matters. The government has also made two summary booklets for the public to read.

levels.text: 行政長官李家超將於明天發表《香港第一個五年規劃》和新一份《施政報告》。他表示，《五年規劃》的封面用藍色，代表開放和穩重；《施政報告》繼續用綠色，代表希望和活力。他又說，《五年規劃》不是計劃經濟，而是說明香港未來的方向和落實方法；《施政報告》就是根據這個方向，安排香港整體的工作。兩份文件合共超過十萬字，政府已經製作兩本摘要，方便市民了解重點。
levels.text_en: Chief Executive John Lee will publish 'Hong Kong's First Five-Year Plan' and a new 'Policy Address' tomorrow. He said the cover of the 'Five-Year Plan' uses blue, representing openness and steadiness; the 'Policy Address' continues to use green, representing hope and vitality. He also said the 'Five-Year Plan' is not a planned economy, but explains Hong Kong's future direction and how to implement it; the 'Policy Address' is based on this direction to arrange Hong Kong's overall work. The two documents together exceed one hundred thousand words, and the government has already produced two summary booklets to help the public understand the key points.

levels.text: 行政長官李家超將於明天發表《香港第一個五年規劃》及新一份《施政報告》。李家超表示，《五年規劃》封面為藍色，代表藍天、開放、進步和穩重；《施政報告》將沿用綠色，代表政策延續性、活力和希望。 李家超表示，《五年規劃》並非計劃經濟，而是指出香港未來戰略方向的規劃，以及落實執行的藍圖；《施政報告》則是以《五年規劃》的長遠目光，謀劃香港全局。兩份文件合共超過十萬字，政府已製作兩冊的摘要，協助市民了解重點。
levels.text_en: Chief Executive John Lee will publish 'Hong Kong's First Five-Year Plan' and a new 'Policy Address' tomorrow. Lee said the cover of the 'Five-Year Plan' is blue, representing blue skies, openness, progress, and steadiness; the 'Policy Address' will continue to use green, representing policy continuity, vitality, and hope. Lee said the 'Five-Year Plan' is not a planned economy, but rather a plan that points out Hong Kong's future strategic direction, as well as a blueprint for implementation; the 'Policy Address,' meanwhile, uses the long-term vision of the 'Five-Year Plan' to plan Hong Kong's overall situation. The two documents together exceed one hundred thousand words, and the government has already produced two volumes of summaries to help the public understand the key points.

articles.title: Diablo V 於 BlizzCon 2026 公佈後 : 官方詳細資料補充：職業、世界觀及介面等
articles.summary: 暴雪喺BlizzCon 2026公佈咗新作《暗黑破壞神 V》，預計2029年出，仲有好多新資料同新職業。

levels.text: 暴雪喺BlizzCon度公佈咗新遊戲《暗黑破壞神 V》。呢個遊戲預計2029年推出。佢哋話由2027年開始會不斷出資料。新遊戲有好多職業，仲有一個新職業叫瘟疫騎士。故事發生喺D4之後一百年，嗰時Diablo已經攻陷咗聖休亞瑞。
levels.text_en: Blizzard announced the new game Diablo V at BlizzCon. This game is expected to launch in 2029. They said starting from 2027 they will keep releasing information about it. The new game has many classes, including a new class called Plague Knight. The story takes place 100 years after D4, at a time when Diablo has already conquered Sanctuary.

levels.text: 暴雪在BlizzCon 2026公布了《暗黑破壞神 V》，預計2029年春季推出。官方表示會從2027年起定期公開開發情報。這次新遊戲的職業數量打破系列紀錄，還加入了新職業瘟疫騎士。世界背景設定在D4之後一百年，Diablo已經征服聖休亞瑞七年。玩家將扮演衛斯馬屈繼承人，可以進入恐懼領域。裝備系統參考了《暗黑破壞神 II》的設計，並加入符文與套裝系統。
levels.text_en: Blizzard announced Diablo V at BlizzCon 2026, expected to launch in spring 2029. The officials said they will regularly release development information starting from 2027. This new game's number of classes breaks the series record, and also adds a new class called Plague Knight. The world setting is 100 years after D4, with Diablo having conquered Sanctuary for seven years. Players will play as the heir of Westmarch, who can enter the Realm of Terror. The equipment system draws on the design of Diablo II, adding runes and set item systems.

levels.text:
Blizzard 於 BlizzCon 2026 正式公開續作《暗黑破壞神 V》（Diablo V），預計 2029 年春季發售（平台未定），並規劃自 2027 年起定期公開開發情報。公佈後，隨即在 Panel 討論環節及幾個媒露訪問中，露了更多相關的資料。

曾想製成 D4 DLC

開發初期曾討論把這些構想做成《暗黑破壞神 IV》資料片還是獨立續作，但因需要改動遊戲底層結構，最終決定另開新作。D4 未來將專注於賽季更新延續故事，而官方亦表示，只要仍有玩家便會繼續支援，D5 上市不代表 D4 會即時停止營運。

首發職業數量打破紀錄

《Diablo V》首發職業數量將打破系列紀錄。首波公開的回歸職業包括狩魔獵人（雙弩高機動性）與武僧（近戰拳腳與神聖遠程）。新職業瘟疫騎士（Plague Knight），則是靈感源自中世紀刑具「鐵處女」的重甲控場角色，玩法圍繞在戰場散播並消耗疾病來獲取力量。

主角雖有明確的故事設定，玩家仍可自由選擇性別、外觀與職業組合，開發團隊希望進一步分開「角色在故事中的身份」與「玩家選擇的職業」。

▲狩魔獵人 Concept

▲Monk Concept  ▲新職業 : 瘟疫騎士

AI 生成迷宮與流動商隊

探索體驗迎來重大轉變，地表與地下城重新採用程序生成技術，玩家再次進入區域時，地形、路線、地標、怪物及獎勵都有機會改變，重現早期探索未知的緊張感。

傳統固定城鎮則被流動商隊（Caravan）取代，商隊會隨玩家探索移動。途中救出的生還者會加入商隊，成為工匠、商人或夥伴；目前已知角色包括目盲之眼修道會前成員，以及一隻擁有個人故事的寶藏哥布林。

商隊本身亦會隨進度擴張及升級，不同成員擁有反映自身背景的馬車，重要冒險取得的戰利品（Trophy）亦會展示在營地。由於世界中已幾乎沒有傳統路邊 Quest Giver，商隊成員亦會成為主要支線內容來源，任務會圍繞各人的背景及個人故事展開。

裝備系統向 Diablo II 取經

受到《Diablo II》啟發，裝備設計以「深度、清晰度與物品身份」為核心。其中 Inventory 物品欄會重新採用不同尺寸設計，大型武器及裝備會佔用多個格數，而非所有物品都是相同大小；腰帶部位亦會回歸。Panel 展示的 Inventory 目前仍屬 Concept Art，最終介面尚未定案。

符文與符文之語（Runes & Runewords）以及套裝系統亦會重新登場，團隊希望套裝增加 Build 組合的多樣性，而非限制玩法。物品亦會設有不同 Tier，初期較為簡單，之後隨角色成長逐步發展。

此外，遊戲將加入較深入的 Crafting 製作系統，設計會吸收《Diablo IV: Lord of Hatred》的經驗。團隊目前亦正測試裝備屬性需求（Stat Requirements），即部分裝備可能要求角色達到指定屬性數值才能使用，但這項設計尚未確定會保留至正式版。

世界設定為 D4 百年後

故事背景設定於 D4 約 100 年後，Diablo 已經征服聖休亞瑞 7 年，世界處於淪陷狀態。Diablo 更把聖休亞瑞視為進攻高階天堂的踏腳石，並利用人類及靈魂作為「永恆之戰」的力量。

玩家將扮演「衛斯馬屈繼承人」，擁有進入「恐懼領域」（Terror Realm）並存活的特殊能力，與 Diablo 存在未解的神秘連結。

官方強調 Diablo 將維持純粹邪惡的形象，不會被塑造成「其實有苦衷」的灰色反派，但其手段會更着重心理操控與恐懼。高階天堂則依舊對人類處境冷漠，玩家亦會找到一名天使盟友，甚至有機會利用地獄力量反過來對付地獄。

目前技能樹與 Endgame 玩法尚未公開，是否設有巔峰、交易及 PvP 等系統亦未確認，完整戰鬥手感、Build 深度及刷裝體驗仍待 2027 年後的開發情報進一步揭露。

▲《Diablo V》的故事從「英雄已經失敗」開始，玩家面對的是 Diablo 已成功征服 Sanctuary 後的世界。
levels.text_en:
Blizzard officially unveiled the sequel Diablo V at BlizzCon 2026, expected to release in spring 2029 (platforms not yet decided), and plans to regularly reveal development information starting from 2027. After the announcement, more related information was revealed during the panel discussion and several media interviews.

Once considered as a D4 DLC

In early development, there was discussion about whether to make these ideas into a Diablo IV expansion or an independent sequel, but because it would require changes to the game's underlying structure, they ultimately decided to create a new standalone title. D4 will focus on seasonal updates to continue its story in the future, and officials stated that as long as there are still players, they will continue to support it — the launch of D5 does not mean D4 will immediately stop operating.

Launch class count breaks records

The number of classes at launch for Diablo V will break the series record. The first wave of revealed returning classes includes the Demon Hunter (dual crossbows, high mobility) and the Monk (melee fists and holy ranged attacks). The new class, Plague Knight, is a heavily armored control-type character inspired by the medieval torture device the "Iron Maiden," with gameplay centered around spreading and consuming disease on the battlefield to gain power.

Although the protagonist has a clearly defined story identity, players can still freely choose gender, appearance, and class combination — the development team hopes to further separate "the character's identity in the story" from "the class chosen by the player."

▲Demon Hunter Concept

▲Monk Concept ▲New class: Plague Knight

AI-generated dungeons and mobile caravans

The exploration experience will undergo a major transformation — both the overworld and dungeons will once again use procedural generation technology. When players re-enter an area, the terrain, routes, landmarks, monsters, and rewards may all change, recreating the early tension of exploring the unknown.

The traditional fixed towns will be replaced by a mobile Caravan, which moves along with the player's exploration. Survivors rescued along the way will join the caravan, becoming craftsmen, merchants, or companions; currently known characters include a former member of the Vizjerei's Blind Eye order, and a treasure goblin with its own personal story.

The caravan itself will also expand and upgrade as progress is made, with different members having wagons reflecting their own backgrounds. Trophies obtained from important adventures will also be displayed at the camp. Since the world now has almost no traditional roadside quest givers, caravan members will become the main source of side content, with quests revolving around each character's background and personal story.

Equipment system draws inspiration from Diablo II

Inspired by Diablo II, the equipment design centers on "depth, clarity, and item identity." The inventory will once again adopt different item sizes — large weapons and equipment will take up multiple slots, rather than all items being the same size; the belt slot will also return. The inventory shown in the panel is currently only concept art, and the final interface has not yet been finalized.

Runes and Runewords, as well as the set item system, will also make a comeback. The team hopes that sets will increase the diversity of build combinations rather than restrict gameplay. Items will also have different tiers, starting simple and gradually developing as the character grows.

In addition, the game will include a more in-depth crafting system, with the design drawing on the experience from Diablo IV: Lord of Hatred. The team is also currently testing equipment stat requirements — meaning some gear may require the character to reach specified stat values before it can be used — but it has not yet been decided whether this design will be kept in the final version.

World set 100 years after D4

The story is set about 100 years after D4. Diablo has conquered Sanctuary for 7 years, and the world is in a fallen state. Diablo now views Sanctuary as a stepping stone to attack the High Heavens, using humans and souls as strength for the "Eternal Conflict."

Players will play as the "Heir of Westmarch," possessing the special ability to enter the "Terror Realm" and survive, with an unresolved mysterious connection to Diablo.

Officials emphasized that Diablo will remain purely evil in image, and will not be portrayed as a "morally grey" villain with a sympathetic backstory — but his methods will place greater emphasis on psychological manipulation and fear. The High Heavens remain indifferent to humanity's plight, and players will find an angelic ally, and may even have the chance to use the power of Hell against Hell itself.

The skill tree and endgame gameplay have not yet been revealed, and it is unconfirmed whether systems such as Paragon, trading, and PvP will be included. The full combat feel, build depth, and gear-farming experience will have to wait for further development information after 2027.

▲Diablo V's story begins with "the heroes have already failed" — players face a world in which Diablo has already succeeded in conquering Sanctuary.

articles.title: 特朗普提出愛爾蘭統一　貝安德指再次舉行北愛邊界公投意願不大
articles.summary: 特朗普話想愛爾蘭同北愛爾蘭合埋一齊，但英國首相貝安德話而家啲人唔想再投票決定呢件事。

levels.text: 特朗普去咗愛爾蘭，他想愛爾蘭同北愛統一，認為會有好處。佢喺都柏林同馬丁一齊見記者，提到兩邊都有朋友，都係好人。不過英國首相貝安德表示，好多人唔想再投票決定北愛的事，他的立場沒變。
levels.text_en: Trump went to Ireland. He wants Ireland and Northern Ireland to unite, believing it would bring benefits. He met reporters together with Martin in Dublin, mentioning that he has friends on both sides, all good people. However, UK Prime Minister Starmer said many people don't want to vote again on the Northern Ireland issue, and his position hasn't changed.

levels.text: 特朗普訪問愛爾蘭時提出，希望愛爾蘭同北愛爾蘭可以統一。他在都柏林同愛爾蘭總理馬丁一起見記者，說自己在兩地都有很好的朋友。他覺得統一是好事，對雙方都有好處，又認為馬丁有能力推動。不過他預料英國會有意見。英國首相貝安德早前講過，英國人普遍不想再就北愛邊界問題舉行公投。首相府發言人之後回應，強調貝安德的立場沒有改變。
levels.text_en: During his visit to Ireland, Trump raised the idea that Ireland and Northern Ireland could unite. He met reporters together with Irish Taoiseach Martin in Dublin, saying he has very good friends in both places. He felt unification would be a good thing, beneficial to both sides, and thought Martin was capable of making it happen. However, he expected the UK would have opinions about it. UK Prime Minister Starmer had earlier said that British people generally don't want to hold another referendum on the Northern Ireland border issue. A spokesperson for the Prime Minister's office later responded, stressing that Starmer's position has not changed.

levels.text: 美國總統特朗普訪問愛爾蘭期間，提出希望見到愛爾蘭與北愛爾蘭統一，認為會有好處。 特朗普在愛爾蘭首都都柏林，與總理馬丁一同見記者時，提到自己在愛爾蘭和北愛都有朋友，而且都是很好的人，如果愛爾蘭能夠統一是好事，對各方都有好處，又認為馬丁有能力推動這件事。不過特朗普說，預計英國對這個議題會很有意見。 英國首相貝安德早前表示，英國民眾普遍對於再次舉行北愛邊界公投的意願不大，首相府發言人在特朗普發表愛爾蘭統一的言論後亦回應，強調貝安德的立場不變。
levels.text_en: During his visit to Ireland, US President Trump expressed hope of seeing Ireland and Northern Ireland unite, believing it would bring benefits. Speaking to reporters alongside Taoiseach Martin in Dublin, the Irish capital, Trump mentioned that he has friends in both Ireland and Northern Ireland, and they are all very good people. He said that if Ireland could be unified, it would be a good thing, beneficial to all sides, and he believed Martin had the ability to push this forward. However, Trump said he expected the UK would have strong opinions on this issue. UK Prime Minister Starmer had earlier said that the British public generally has little appetite for holding another referendum on the Northern Ireland border. After Trump's remarks on Irish unification, a spokesperson for the Prime Minister's office responded, emphasizing that Starmer's position remains unchanged.

articles.summary_en: US President Trump visited Ireland and spoke publicly, alongside Irish PM (Taoiseach) Micheál Martin, about wanting to see Ireland and Northern Ireland unified; this raised the sensitive issue of a possible future border poll on Northern Ireland's status, prompting a response from UK PM Keir Starmer's office.

articles.title: 【葉底藏花】GenAI（仍遠遠）不是新進化物種   ——唯物史觀、達爾文想像與生物類比的謬誤  – 鄒崇銘
articles.summary: 呢篇文話大家成日誤解咗達爾文講嘅「物競天擇」，仲用錯咗嘅諗法去睇GenAI。

levels.text: 呢篇文講馬克思寫嘅《資本論》，同達爾文嘅進化論好似，但好多人誤解咗「物競天擇，適者生存」呢句嘢。其實達爾文冇話邊個最叻先可以生存，只係話邊個啱環境先叫做適應到。而家啲人用呢種諗法去講GenAI，都係搞錯咗。
levels.text_en: This article talks about how Marx's Capital is similar to Darwin's theory of evolution, but many people misunderstand the phrase 'natural selection, survival of the fittest.' Actually, Darwin never said the smartest one survives — he only meant whoever fits the environment is considered 'adapted.' Nowadays people use this kind of thinking to talk about GenAI, and that's also a mistake.

levels.text: 呢篇文由鄒崇銘寫，講馬克思嘅《資本論》同達爾文嘅《物種起源》雖然係唔同範疇嘅書，但都反映住啟蒙運動嗰種對進步嘅想像。好多人以為「物競天擇，適者生存」係達爾文講嘅，其實係嚴復譯赫胥黎嘅《天演論》先出現，「適者生存」呢句仲係史賓塞創造。史賓塞式嘅「社會達爾文主義」帶住種族主義色彩，早就被人批評。達爾文原意嘅「適者」唔係話最強最叻，而係話喺特定環境入面啱唔啱適應，同氣候、資源、合作都有關。文章話而家啲人成日將GenAI比喻做進化過程嘅新物種，其實都係受咗呢種誤解嘅影響。
levels.text_en: This article, written by Chau Sung-ming, discusses how Marx's Capital and Darwin's Origin of Species, though belonging to different fields, both reflect the Enlightenment's imagination of 'progress.' Many people think 'natural selection, survival of the fittest' was said by Darwin, but actually it first appeared when Yan Fu translated Huxley's Tianyanlun (Evolution and Ethics), and the phrase 'survival of the fittest' was actually coined by Spencer. Spencer-style 'Social Darwinism' carries racist overtones and has long been criticized. Darwin's original meaning of 'the fittest' was not about being the strongest or smartest, but about whether something is suited to a specific environment, which relates to climate, resources, and cooperation. The article says that people nowadays constantly use the metaphor of GenAI as a new species in an evolutionary process, which is actually influenced by this same misunderstanding.

levels.text: 文章指出，馬克思喺1867年出版嘅《資本論》，同早八年面世、達爾文嘅《物種源始》（1859），雖然屬於完全不同嘅學術範疇，卻同樣承載住啟蒙運動對「進步」嘅想像，構成現代文明嘅深層文化底蘊。作者特別提到，「物競天擇，適者生存」呢句廣為人知嘅名言，其實並非出自達爾文本人，而係十九世紀末嚴復翻譯赫胥黎《天演論》時所用，「適者生存」呢詞更加係英國哲學家史賓塞喺1864年提出。嚴復翻譯時融入咗史賓塞嘅「社會達爾文主義」思想，令呢種帶種族主義同帝國主義色彩嘅理論廣泛流傳，但早已受到學術界批評。作者強調，達爾文所講嘅「fittest」並非指最強或最先進，而係指物種喺特定環境入面嘅相對適應，涉及氣候、地景、水源、繁殖同共生等因素。進化並唔係一場淘汰賽，而係不斷分化同適應嘅過程。文章暗示，將呢種誤解類比套用喺GenAI身上，都係一種謬誤。
levels.text_en: The article points out that Marx's Capital, published in 1867, and Darwin's On the Origin of Species (1859), which appeared eight years earlier, though belonging to completely different academic fields, both carry the Enlightenment's imagination of 'progress,' forming a deep cultural foundation of modern civilization. The author specifically notes that the well-known saying 'natural selection, survival of the fittest' did not actually come from Darwin himself, but was used by Yan Fu in his translation of Huxley's Tianyanlun in the late 19th century, and the term 'survival of the fittest' was actually proposed by the British philosopher Spencer in 1864. When translating, Yan Fu incorporated Spencer's 'Social Darwinism' ideas, causing this theory — which carries racist and imperialist overtones — to spread widely, though it has long been criticized by academia. The author emphasizes that what Darwin meant by 'fittest' was not the strongest or most advanced, but rather a species' relative adaptation within a specific environment, involving factors such as climate, terrain, water sources, reproduction, and symbiosis. Evolution is not an elimination contest, but a continuous process of differentiation and adaptation. The article implies that applying this same misunderstanding as an analogy to GenAI is likewise a fallacy.

levels.text: 作者指出，馬克思的《資本論》與達爾文的進化論雖屬不同學科，卻同樣體現了啟蒙運動對「進步」的想像。許多人以為「物競天擇，適者生存」出自達爾文，其實這句話源於嚴復翻譯赫胥黎的《天演論》，而「適者生存」一詞則是英國哲學家史賓塞提出的。史賓塞式的「社會達爾文主義」帶有種族主義色彩，早被學術界批評。作者強調，達爾文所說的「適者」並非指最強或最先進，而是指物種在特定環境中的適應程度，這涉及氣候、資源、繁殖與共生等多種因素。進化不是一場由強者勝出的淘汰賽，而是不斷分化與適應的過程。文章最後指出，將這種誤解套用於理解GenAI，同樣是一種謬誤。
levels.text_en: The author points out that although Marx's Capital and Darwin's theory of evolution belong to different disciplines, they both embody the Enlightenment's imagination of 'progress.' Many people believe that 'natural selection, survival of the fittest' comes from Darwin, but in fact this phrase originates from Yan Fu's translation of Huxley's Tianyanlun, while the term 'survival of the fittest' was proposed by the British philosopher Spencer. Spencer-style 'Social Darwinism' carries racist overtones and has long been criticized by academia. The author emphasizes that what Darwin meant by 'the fittest' was not the strongest or most advanced, but rather the degree of a species' adaptation within a specific environment, involving factors such as climate, resources, reproduction, and symbiosis. Evolution is not an elimination contest won by the strong, but a continuous process of differentiation and adaptation. The article concludes by pointing out that applying this same misunderstanding to understanding GenAI is likewise a fallacy.

levels.text: 近160年前，馬克思出版了《資本論》（1867），奠下了一個多世紀以來，人們對某種進步或高階社會的理想、或幻想。 這裡倒不是要搶閘對《資本論》作回顧，而是更具針對性地力圖論證：《資本論》以至馬克思的 「唯物史觀」（historical materialism），儘管和僅僅早八年面世、 達爾文 的《物種源始》 （1859），屬於完全不同學術範疇的著作；但卻同樣承載著濃厚的 啟蒙運動的精神想像，共同構成 現代文明的深層文化底蘊，兩者著實存在著驚人的相似之處。 尤其重要的是：這些涉及高階社會、生命、物種和進化的類比，對當下關於「生成式人工智能」 （GenAI）的普遍誤解，實在造成了舉足輕重的重大影響。 對「物競天擇，適者生存」的長期誤解 所謂「物競天擇，適者生存」，相信大家自小都已耳熟能詳。很多人都知道，這句中文名言，乃來 自十九世紀末嚴復所翻譯、達爾文追隨者赫胥黎撰寫的《天演論》 (1893)，而並非直接來自達爾文 的《物種起源》。尤其「適者生存」（survival of the fittest）一語，更不是達爾文原創，而是英國 哲學家史賓塞在1864年提出。 嚴復在翻譯赫胥黎時，曾大量融入史賓塞的「社會達爾文主義」（Social Darwinism）思想，遂令 「物競天擇，適者生存」廣為流傳，成為華文世界理解進化論最深入民心的八個字。 很多人卻未必知道，「適者生存」即使後來獲達爾文本人接納，卻極易對進化論的原來含意造成扭 曲。時至今日，大概很少人會全盤否定達爾文的進化論；但史賓塞式的社會達爾文主義，尤其是它 濃烈種族主義、帝國主義和歷史命定論的意味，早已受到學術界的廣泛批判。大概只有少數極右翼 法西斯主義者，仍對史賓塞思想一直加以堅持。 若我們並不是談史賓塞，而是回到達爾文本身：所謂的fittest，便不等於最強壯、最聰明、最先進， 更絕不代表在競爭中擊敗其他物種的勝利者。它首先指向的，是不同物種在特定環境中的相對成功 適應。適應過程固然會受到物種之間競爭的影響，卻也取決於氣候、地景、水源、養分、繁殖、合 作、共生，以至無數其他的生態互動關係。 換句話說，進化並不是一場所有生命參與競逐、最終由最強者勝出的淘汰賽；更不是一條從「低 等」生命，逐步攀升至「高等」生命的單向階梯。 其實只需放眼我們身處的地球便知道。 自從五億多年前的寒武紀大爆發，到今天極為繁複的生境和生物多樣性，進化並非一物種接另一物 種登上冠軍寶座，而是不斷分化、繁衍和適應的混雜過程。各種生命在迥異的環境中生生不息、百 花齊放——假如進化真的只有最強者勝出，那麼地球上絕大部分的生命，豈不早就應被淘汰殆盡？ 試問又怎會出現今天這個由細菌、真菌、植物、昆蟲、魚類、鳥類、哺乳類，以至無數微生物相依 相偎、共存共榮的繁盛生命世界？ 從「社會達爾文主義」到「唯物史觀」 馬克思在撰寫《資本論》期間，顯然已相當
levels.text_en:
Nearly 160 years ago, Marx published Capital (1867), laying the groundwork for over a century of people's ideals — or illusions — about some kind of progress or higher-order society. This piece is not meant to be a retrospective review of Capital, but aims more specifically to argue: that Capital, and indeed Marx's 'historical materialism,' although belonging to a completely different academic field from Darwin's On the Origin of Species (published a mere eight years earlier, in 1859), nevertheless carries the same rich imaginative spirit of the Enlightenment. Together the two works form the deep cultural foundation of modern civilization, and indeed there are striking similarities between them. Most importantly: these analogies involving higher society, life, species, and evolution have had a decisive and major influence on today's widespread misunderstanding of 'Generative AI' (GenAI). 

On the long-standing misunderstanding of 'natural selection, survival of the fittest': Everyone has likely been familiar with this saying since childhood. Many people know that this famous Chinese phrase actually comes from Tianyanlun (Evolution and Ethics, 1893), translated in the late 19th century by Yan Fu from the work of Huxley, a follower of Darwin — not directly from Darwin's own Origin of Species. In particular, the phrase 'survival of the fittest' was not coined by Darwin at all, but was proposed by the British philosopher Herbert Spencer in 1864. When Yan Fu translated Huxley's work, he incorporated a large amount of Spencer's 'Social Darwinism' thinking, causing 'natural selection, survival of the fittest' to spread widely and become the eight-character phrase through which the Chinese-speaking world most deeply understood evolution. 

However, many people may not know that 'survival of the fittest,' even though it was later accepted by Darwin himself, can very easily distort the original meaning of evolutionary theory. Today, few people would completely deny Darwin's theory of evolution; but Spencer-style Social Darwinism — especially its strong overtones of racism, imperialism, and historical determinism — has long been widely criticized by academia. Probably only a small number of far-right fascists still cling to Spencer's ideas. 

If we set Spencer aside and return to Darwin himself: the so-called 'fittest' does not mean the strongest, the smartest, or the most advanced, and certainly does not mean the victor who defeats other species in competition. What it primarily refers to is the relative successful adaptation of different species within a specific environment. While the adaptation process is indeed influenced by competition between species, it also depends on climate, terrain, water sources, nutrients, reproduction, cooperation, symbiosis, and countless other ecological interactions. 

In other words, evolution is not an elimination contest in which all living things compete and the strongest ultimately wins; nor is it a one-way ladder climbing step by step from 'lower' life forms to 'higher' ones. 

In fact, one only needs to look at the planet we live on to see this. From the Cambrian explosion over 500 million years ago to today's extremely complex habitats and biodiversity, evolution is not a matter of one species after another ascending to a championship throne, but rather a mixed, continuous process of differentiation, reproduction, and adaptation. Various life forms thrive and flourish in vastly different environments — if evolution really only meant the strongest winning, wouldn't the vast majority of life on Earth have long since been eliminated? How else could today's flourishing world of life exist, where bacteria, fungi, plants, insects, fish, birds, mammals, and countless microorganisms depend on each other and coexist in mutual prosperity?

articles.summary_en: This is an opinion piece by Chau Sung-ming (鄒崇銘) arguing that people misunderstand Darwin's phrase 'survival of the fittest' and are wrongly applying that misunderstanding as an analogy when talking about GenAI (generative AI) as if it were a new evolving species; the article also connects this to Marx's Capital and 19th-century Chinese translations of evolutionary theory.

articles.title: 【專訪劉香成．上】紀實攝影人眼中的世界：蘇聯解體與中國崛起
articles.summary: 呢篇文講攝影師劉香成點樣影相記錄新中國同蘇聯嘅歷史大事。

levels.text: 劉香成係一個影相記者，佢喺美國雜誌做嘢，之後返去中國影相。佢細個喺福州大，屋企唔係紅五類，冇戴紅領巾。毛澤東死咗之後，佢返中國影好多日常生活嘅相。佢出咗本書叫《苦海餘生》，講中國人辛苦嘅生活。書入面有好多相，有孩子鬥四人幫，又有人睇大字報。
levels.text_en: Liu Heung Shing is a photojournalist who worked at an American magazine and then went back to China to take photos. As a child he grew up in Fuzhou; his family was not from the 'red five categories' and he didn't wear a red scarf. After Mao Zedong died, he went back to China and photographed a lot of everyday life. He published a book called 'Bitter Sea Survivors' about the hard lives of Chinese people. The book had many photos, including children denouncing the Gang of Four and people reading big-character posters.

levels.text: 劉香成係一個紀實攝影記者，1978年派駐中國，做《時代》雜誌記者，係首八個派駐北京嘅美國記者之一。佢細個喺福州長大，父親做過《大公報》編輯，母親係大地主後代，所以佢喺班度係唯一冇戴紅領巾嘅同學。長大後佢去美國讀國際關係，仲學埋攝影，之後做咗《時代》同美聯社嘅首席攝影記者。毛澤東去世之後，佢返返去中國，見證新時代開始。1983年，佢出咗本書，收錄1976到1982年嘅相片，有四人幫被鬥、西單民主牆、農民收割白菜等等，記錄中國普通人嘅日常生活。呢本書後尾改名叫做《A Life in a Sea of Red》。
levels.text_en: Liu Heung Shing is a documentary photojournalist who was posted to China in 1978 as a reporter for Time magazine, one of the first eight American journalists stationed in Beijing. He grew up in Fuzhou as a child; his father had been an editor at Ta Kung Pao, and his mother came from a family of large landowners, so he was the only student in his class who didn't wear a red scarf. After growing up he went to the US to study international relations and also studied photography, later becoming chief photographer for both Time and the Associated Press. After Mao Zedong's death, he went back to China and witnessed the beginning of a new era. In 1983, he published a book collecting photos taken between 1976 and 1982, including the denunciation of the Gang of Four, the Xidan Democracy Wall, farmers harvesting cabbage, and more, recording the everyday life of ordinary Chinese people. This book was later renamed 'A Life in a Sea of Red'.

levels.text: 劉香成係一位紀實攝影師，1978年以《時代》雜誌記者身份派駐中國，係首八位派駐北京嘅美國記者之一，翌年中美就正式建交。佢細個喺福州長大，父親曾任《大公報》編輯，母親係清官後代、大地主，因此佢被視為「黑五類」後代，係全班唯一冇戴紅領巾嘅學生。長大後佢赴美修讀國際關係，並因選修攝影師Gjon Mili嘅課程而成為佢嘅實習生，之後展開專業攝影生涯，先後擔任《時代》同美聯社嘅首席攝影記者。毛澤東去世之後，劉香成雖然趕唔切採訪葬禮，但剛好見證新時代嘅開始。1983年，佢將1976至1982年拍攝嘅照片輯錄成書，內容包括孩子批鬥四人幫、北京市民圍觀西單民主牆嘅大字報、農民收割白菜、青年喺毛澤東像前玩滑輪等等，呈現中國庶民嘅日常生活。呢本書2010年先至喺內地出版，因為原本嘅書名被視為政治唔正確。
levels.text_en: Liu Heung Shing is a documentary photographer who was posted to China in 1978 as a Time magazine correspondent, one of the first eight American journalists stationed in Beijing; the following year, China and the US formally established diplomatic relations. He grew up in Fuzhou; his father had once been an editor at Ta Kung Pao, and his mother was descended from an official family and large landowners, so he was regarded as belonging to the 'black five categories' and was the only student in his class who didn't wear a red scarf. After growing up he went to the US to study international relations, and because he took a photography course taught by photographer Gjon Mili, he became his intern, launching his professional photography career; he later served as chief photographer for both Time and the Associated Press. After Mao Zedong died, although Liu didn't make it back in time to cover the funeral, he happened to witness the start of a new era. In 1983, he compiled photos taken between 1976 and 1982 into a book, including children denouncing the Gang of Four, Beijing residents gathering to view big-character posters at the Xidan Democracy Wall, farmers harvesting cabbage, and young people roller-skating in front of a statue of Mao Zedong—capturing the everyday life of ordinary Chinese people. The book was only published in mainland China in 2010, because its original title was considered politically incorrect.

levels.text: 劉香成是一位紀實攝影師。1978年，他以《時代》雜誌記者身份被派到中國，是首八位派駐北京的美國記者之一。他小時候在福州長大，父親曾任《大公報》編輯，母親出身大地主家庭，因此他被視為「黑五類」後代，是全班唯一沒有戴紅領巾的學生。長大後他到美國讀國際關係，又跟隨攝影師Gjon Mili學習攝影，後來成為《時代》和美聯社的首席攝影記者。毛澤東去世後，他回到中國，正好見證一個新時代的開始。1983年，他把1976至1982年拍攝的照片編成一本書，記錄了批鬥四人幫、西單民主牆、農民收割白菜等場景，呈現普通中國人的日常生活。這本書直到2010年才在內地出版，因為原本的書名被認為政治不正確。
levels.text_en: Liu Heung Shing is a documentary photographer. In 1978, he was posted to China as a Time magazine correspondent, one of the first eight American journalists stationed in Beijing. He grew up in Fuzhou as a child; his father had been an editor at Ta Kung Pao, and his mother came from a family of large landowners, so he was regarded as being descended from the 'black five categories' and was the only student in his class who didn't wear a red scarf. After growing up he went to the US to study international relations, and also studied photography under photographer Gjon Mili, later becoming chief photographer for Time and the Associated Press. After Mao Zedong's death, he returned to China and happened to witness the beginning of a new era. In 1983, he compiled photos he had taken between 1976 and 1982 into a book, documenting scenes such as the denunciation of the Gang of Four, the Xidan Democracy Wall, and farmers harvesting cabbage—capturing the everyday life of ordinary Chinese people. The book wasn't published in mainland China until 2010, because its original title was considered politically incorrect.

levels.text: 一. 苦海過後的新中國 美國已故總統尼克遜（Richard Nixon）於1972年訪華後，美國媒體開始對中國產生較大的興趣。那時，美國三大報刊記者Fox Butterfield（《紐約時報》）、Richard Bernstein（《時代》雜誌）、Jay Mathews（《華盛頓郵報》）爭先出版一部關於中國的書，劉香成在1978年作為《時代》雜誌記者派駐中國，是首八位派駐北京的美國記者之一。翌年，中美便正式建交了。 最終Fox Butterfield搶先出版了，書名為《苦海餘生》（China：Alive in the Bitter Sea，1982），書中照片都是劉香成的作品。「這本書在那個時代是比較深刻的報道，可以說是很有分量、關於新中國的報道。」劉香成的新書書名叫做 《A Life in a Sea of Red》 （中文暫譯作《紅海餘生》），正是呼應該部三十七年前的作品。 「苦海餘生是中國道家思想，形容人類要過這一生所面對的是苦海，社會狀況多多少少都是很苦的。在這麼苦的人生裏面，你怎樣找到平衡，找到自己生活的理念。所以，苦海餘生是形容中國人很深刻的生活體驗。」這種苦，也許年幼時的劉香成也嘗過一點：1951年出生於香港，十歲前在福州念書，父親是知識分子，曾任《大公報》編輯，母親則是清官後代、大地主，因此，劉香成作為「黑五類」後代，是班中幾十名同學之中，唯一沒帶上紅領巾的。 正因在內地度過童年，使劉香成對中國、對政治有了興趣，長大後就到美國念國際關係，因選修《Life》雜誌攝影師Gjon Mili的攝影課，輾轉做了他的實習生，展開了自己的專業生涯，先後擔任《時代》及美聯社的首席攝影記者。 毛澤東去世之後，也是劉香成回到中國的時機，雖然趕不及回去採訪毛澤東的葬禮，卻剛好見證一個新時代之始。「在大陸，我從第一天就知道這是人類一個很大的故事，如果這個故事那麼大，而我又做紀實攝影的，你不去為這故事投資時間、精力，那還有什麼可做？」 1983年，劉香成首度把攝於1976至1982年的照片輯錄成書：孩子高舉拳頭批鬥四人幫、七十年代末北京市民圍看「西單民主牆」大字報、北京農民收割大白菜、大連青年在毛澤東像前玩滑輪，年輕情侶在街上依偎，或是穿着列寧裝卻拿着「可口可樂」的青年。 記錄的都是那些年中國庶民的日常，畫面雖然沒他採訪八九民運、韓國民運、蘇聯阿富汗戰爭那麼動魄驚心，也沒政治巨人那麼具標誌性，但眾生相往往是最富詩意的時代見證。這書在1983年初次出版，但至2010年左右才於內地面世。「當時很有趣，大陸不敢稱此書為《毛之後的中國》，在大陸，什麼是political correctness（政治正確）很重要，你叫毛澤東之後的中國，很disrespectful（不尊重）。」 二. 從天安門跑到克里姆林宮 1989年在北京天安門廣場的報道是劉香成的「成名作」之一，獲得新聞界廣
levels.text_en:
I. New China After the Bitter Sea

After the late US President Richard Nixon visited China in 1972, American media began taking greater interest in China. At that time, journalists from three major American publications—Fox Butterfield (The New York Times), Richard Bernstein (Time), and Jay Mathews (The Washington Post)—raced to publish a book about China. Liu Heung Shing was posted to China in 1978 as a Time magazine correspondent, one of the first eight American journalists stationed in Beijing. The following year, China and the US formally established diplomatic relations.

In the end, Fox Butterfield published first, with the book titled 'China: Alive in the Bitter Sea' (1982), and the photographs in the book were all Liu Heung Shing's work. "This book was quite a profound piece of reporting for that era—you could say it was a weighty account of new China," Liu said. Liu's new book is titled 'A Life in a Sea of Red' (tentatively translated as such), echoing that earlier work from thirty-seven years before.

"'Bitter Sea Survivors' comes from Daoist thought in China, describing how the life humans must endure is a bitter sea—social conditions are, to some degree, always bitter. Within such a bitter life, how do you find balance, find your own philosophy of living? So 'Bitter Sea Survivors' describes a profound life experience of the Chinese people." This bitterness was perhaps something Liu Heung Shing himself tasted a little of as a child: born in Hong Kong in 1951, he studied in Fuzhou before the age of ten. His father was an intellectual who had served as an editor at Ta Kung Pao, while his mother was descended from an official family and was from a large landowning family. As a result, Liu, being descended from the 'black five categories,' was the only one among several dozen classmates who never wore a red scarf.

Precisely because he spent his childhood in mainland China, Liu developed an interest in China and in politics. Growing up, he went to the US to study international relations, and through taking a photography course by Life magazine photographer Gjon Mili, he ended up becoming his intern, launching his own professional career. He went on to serve as chief photographer for both Time and the Associated Press.

After Mao Zedong's death, it was also the moment for Liu Heung Shing to return to China. Although he didn't make it back in time to cover Mao Zedong's funeral, he happened to witness the beginning of a new era. "On the mainland, from day one I knew this was a very big story of humanity. If the story is that big, and I'm doing documentary photography, if you don't invest your time and energy into this story, what else is there to do?"

In 1983, Liu Heung Shing for the first time compiled photographs taken between 1976 and 1982 into a book: children raising their fists to denounce the Gang of Four, Beijing residents in the late 1970s gathering to view big-character posters at the 'Xidan Democracy Wall,' Beijing farmers harvesting large cabbages, young people in Dalian roller-skating in front of a statue of Mao Zedong, young couples leaning against each other on the street, or young people wearing Lenin suits while holding Coca-Cola.

What was recorded was the everyday life of ordinary Chinese people during those years. Though the images were not as dramatic or heart-stopping as his coverage of the 1989 pro-democracy movement, the Korean democracy movement, or the Soviet-Afghan war, nor as iconic as photos of political giants, portraits of ordinary people are often the most poetic testimony to an era. This book was first published in 1983, but it wasn't until around 2010 that it appeared in mainland China. "It was quite interesting at the time—the mainland didn't dare call this book 'China After Mao.' In mainland China, what counts as political correctness matters a great deal; calling it 'China after Mao Zedong' would be seen as very disrespectful."

II. From Tiananmen to the Kremlin

The coverage of the 1989 events at Tiananmen Square in Beijing was one of Liu Heung Shing's 'breakthrough works,' earning him wide acclaim in the press industry—[text cuts off]
